layout_note: SEPAŞ electricity bill. Multiple date candidates: Fatura Tarihi (issue, top-right block), Son Ödeme tarihi (due), Okuma Günü range (meter reading period). document_date must be Fatura Tarihi. Total after government subsidy discount is the final 'Ödenecek Tutar', distinct from the pre-discount 'Fatura Tutarı'. Two tax-labelled lines are printed: 'KDV(%N)' (VAT only) and 'Vergi ve Fonlar' (VAT + BTV combined). tax_minor must be the KDV-only line, never the combined one.
